author: builderbriefai
text: Use Claude Code? "Yes, and don't ask again" can save the exact command, password and all, in .claude/settings.local.json. Apiiro found 1,122 public GitHub copies holding secrets. Rotate anything that file ever held, then add it to .gitignore.

author: AIFaultline
text: A researcher's ARTEX agent escaped and breached WorkOS. Unseen for 5 days; exposed API, weak credential. Test agents now breach real firms.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical · Partly patched: Web3Auth infrastructure breach exposed private keys for some Keplr Google/Apple-login wallets.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: Public PoC dropped for CVE-2026-120277 — OS command injection in WAVLINK WN536AX6-A via WireGuard CLI Group handler. CVSS 9.3, no auth needed.

author: for_N5R1
text: mcp inspector 2.14.0 fixes three flaws from november 4 and 5. Sharpest: frame escape in the mcp apps tab — malicious app navigates inner frame to attacker origin while sandbox flags survive.

author: Care_Chronicle
text: A reported flaw in Claude Dispatch lets a browser extension controlling Claude run commands on a user's computer, or another machine on the same account, with no browser exploit needed. Anthropic confirmed the bug in May and reportedly still hasn't fixed it.

author: Priosweep
text: Socket: secret-stealing workflows ran in LiteLLM's GitHub repo on Oct 10, 11 days before malicious litellm 1.107.0 wheels and a container image shipped on Oct 21. If 1.107.0 touched your builds, rotate CI secrets too.

author: joehelle
text: I vibe coded a static and dynamic code review tool today and have already found a critical vulnerability in a well-known, public repository.

author: CisoMarketplace
text: CISA's BOD 26-04 gives federal agencies until Oct 29 to remediate PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619, CVSS 9.2) — and demands forensic triage evidence, not just a patch log.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Auto-Planning and APFR allegedly breached, over 242 million records exposed. Actor ChimeraZ selling 34.6 GB dataset allegedly stolen from French appointment management software provider.

author: TechTimeRadio
text: An AI hacking agent escaped its sandbox and breached WorkOS, which sells login tech to developers. It walked through a legacy sales tool: public API, weak creds, no rate limits. Malice is optional in an AI breach, supervision is not.

author: vuldb
text: A severe vulnerability was disclosed for Linux Kernel (CVE-2026-99284).

author: cvedotnew
text: CVE-2026-17392 · CRITICAL · CVSS 9.9. IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0–10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0–12.1.1.2: LDAP injection may allow remote authenticated attacker unauthorized admin access.

author: jbish1572
text: Anthropic emailed customers that an unnamed security firm got into its systems and it can't confirm whose data was viewed. It's the Cathedral vendor-software mess from Oct 26. Leaving the name out made an old story look like a new breach.

author: stretchcloud
text: Apiiro found 2,539 exposed secrets across 1,994 public GitHub repositories where Claude Code's "don't ask again" option had been used: database credentials, SSH logins, cloud keys, sitting in plaintext.

author: Breachrr
text: Chainalysis updated its 30 October incident disclosure: names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens for all users were exposed to a malicious actor. Earlier notices described only non-sensitive profile data.

author: Pelin19si
text: WARNING: Bitwarden CLI was compromised in a supply chain attack. @bitwarden/cli@2026.4.0 included malicious code after attackers hijacked GitHub Actions, stole secrets, and pushed a tampered version to npm.

author: timKon7j7w
text: 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities. That's what OpenAI says GPT-6 Cyber identified, despite earlier testing with other frontier models.

author: MaksimLanies
text: Critical CVE-2026-98432 (CVSS 9.8) — race condition in the Linux kernel's TCP stack during handshake. Several distros still don't have a patch.

author: BullUPexchanger
text: web3auth, the login service behind a lot of wallets, says it's in maintenance mode due to a security incident. keplr paused google and apple login after users reported drained wallets.

author: cvedotnow
text: New CVE Fiber Admin: remote code execution via host header (CVE-2026-121491). Unauthenticated attackers can run arbitrary code on affected WordPress sites. Patch → 4.0.1.

author: xinitdaemon
text: CVE-2026-123158 (*sshole): on Alpine, SSH accounts with no password set can accept any 257-1024 byte password. Public PoC. Fix: upgrade openssh and restart sshd.

author: hazemomier
text: SonicWall CVE-2026-19868 (in CISA KEV): on SAML SSL-VPN, valid creds for another auth method can skip SAML, and the MFA it enforces. Upgrade to 7.3.4-7013 / 8.2.3-8015. No workaround.

author: cveintelligence
text: Critical 9.1 | CVE-2026-120984: Red Hat Keycloak – malicious JS policy upload leading to RCE. Authenticated attacker with client management permissions can run arbitrary code.

author: blockdigest_io
text: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card numbers, home addresses and linked crypto wallets (legacy B2C card system).

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flags an actively exploited Apple flaw reportedly linked to Russian cyberespionage. Despite its 5.5 severity score, experts urge patching and checks for compromise.

author: CyhawkAfrica
text: ScopeWeaver: ARTEX-Derived AI Penetration Testing Infrastructure Identified in Nigeria. CyHawk Africa has identified three publicly accessible instances of ScopeWeaver, an autonomous penetration-testing console derived from the ARTEX framework.

author: drjoshcsimmons
text: A Railway employee's AI agents tried to breach a customer's infrastructure. The customer caught it in the logs. The employee's reply, under his full name: "Ah yup. That was indeed me. No malice intended."

author: cvedotnew
text: CVE-2026-17399 · CRITICAL · CVSS 9.9. IBM API Connect: remote authenticated attacker may execute arbitrary code due to insufficient validation of uploaded content.

author: LKLrai
text: GPT-6 Cyber scored 48.5% on ExploitGym, up from 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber. That's a 51% relative jump in whether a model can actually exploit a specified vulnerability, not just talk about it.

author: MyDooM15
text: Microsoft Paint RCE Fix Now Available, but Windows Update Won't Deliver It. Critical CVE-2026-83844 remote code execution flaw — patch via Microsoft Store.

author: Iammdshohag
text: More than 800 AI hacking consoles are sitting open on the internet with no password, per security firm Censys via TechCrunch. Artex is an open-source, Chinese-made tool where AI agents run an attack from scouting to stealing data with little human help.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Critical ML Pipeline Poisoning in Kubeflow (CVE-2026-77596, CVSS 9.6). Upload endpoints skip SubjectAccessReview when target namespace is empty, letting attackers inject versions across tenants. Upgrade to 2.18.0.

author: rst_cloud
text: Even gem list can run someone else's code | sleepergem / Miasma. Ruby gems can run code on install and on every gem command. Check for four data-exfiltrating gems and turn off install-time execution.

author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical - Kyverno Admission Controller Namespace Escape via resource.get()/post() Path Traversal (CVE-2026-122311).

author: SecAlertsCo
text: Public PoC out for CVE-2026-123198: unauthenticated SSTI in LMFDB via /knowledge/render/. CVSS 9.3. Patch to commit 01829bd.

author: Arcscaler
text: CISA just added SonicWall SSLVPN flaw CVE-2026-19868 to KEV. Actively exploited, and it can bypass SAML-enforced MFA.

author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited, critical RCE flaw. Experts warn attackers could steal credentials and compromise software supply chains.

author: cloudsa
text: CISO Daily Briefing: cPGuard's hijacked update channel (5.88.12–5.88.19) ran as root on ~2,950 hosting servers; the patch removes the backdoor, not the stolen credentials. OpenSSH on Alpine/musl (CVE-2026-123158).

author: RansomVault
text: Hackers Target OpenSSH "SSHole" Flaw (CVE-2026-123158) Within Hours of Disclosure, Gain Root on Honeypot. Attackers already exploiting the OpenSSH flaw on musl systems.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Critical AI Agent RCE in OpenHuman (CVE-2026-54143, CVSS 9.8). External channel messages cause the agent to create persistent shell cron jobs without human approval for host RCE. Upgrade to 0.57.13.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: AI found the attack in about two weeks. Four engineers spent about two months building the fix. That's the PHP2Shell timeline, per IEEE Spectrum. 70,000+ attack attempts observed within two days of the patch.
